source.upstream: references/styles/01_通用母版/设计流派/全幅摄影编辑风.md

visual_language.direction: photo-led editorial magazine deck, large full-bleed photography dominates each page, restrained text columns and caption blocks beside or over images, thin rules and section numbering, quiet neutral type field so imagery stays loudest, asymmetric magazine composition

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以全幅出血摄影为页面脊柱、文字锚点与图注退后的杂志图片散文节奏,做建筑/设计/时尚/文化的影像主导叙事;大图说话,文字点题
legacy_payload.visual_direction: photo-led editorial magazine deck, large full-bleed photography dominates each page, restrained text columns and caption blocks beside or over images, thin rules and section numbering, quiet neutral type field so imagery stays loudest, asymmetric magazine composition

canvas.background: 安静纸白文字侧 #FAF7F2(摄影承色,文字侧中性退后)
canvas.composition: 大图即脊柱:全幅/贴边图像场 + 克制文字栏/图注块/overlay 标题;非对称杂志构图
canvas.density: low,文字稀少精狠——文字点题不填满

color_palette.rule: 照片承色——图像是最响元素,文字侧刻意低调;一个克制强调只标编号/规则线/关键词,禁多色装饰

typography.title: 编辑衬线大题(思源宋体 / Georgia 系),overlay 标题需 scrim 保读性
typography.body: 干净无衬线正文(Inter / 思源黑体),杂志栏节奏
typography.labels: 小而精的图注与图号,编辑橙单点

layout_patterns: 图主导页 = 全幅/贴边摄影占 70%+ + 窄文字栏或 overlay 标题(压图文字必须 scrim)
图文对页 = 非对称分栏:大图场 + 细规则线 + 小图注块与图号
章节页 = 满版影像 + 编号(C2410C)+ 一行题句
多图页 = 图片散文节奏:1 大 2 小非对称网格 + 各自图注,图间留白呼吸
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 摄影即主视觉,文字为锚:words point, they don't fill;零装饰元素与图竞争
negative_prompt: no decoration competing with the photo — thin rules and numbering only
no busy colorful text side; the type field stays quiet neutral
no overlay text without a scrim gradient where legibility demands
no small centered clip-art images floating on white; photography goes full-bleed or edge-to-edge
legacy_payload.palette_family: editorial-classic(经典编辑)/ dark-cinematic(影展暗场);源规格颜色行为分离——图像主导纪律是风格本体,HEX 可被品牌侧替换

visual_elements.allowed: 全幅摄影,贴边图像场,细规则线,小节编号,图注块,overlay 标题(带 scrim)
visual_elements.avoid: 与图竞争的装饰;多彩文字侧;无 scrim 压图文字;小图浮白

rendering_constraints: Flat — no decorative shadows; the only practical exception is a scrim gradient under overlay text.
Photography supplies the texture; the type side stays understated.

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案
